name: sitting alternate knee to elbow twist
description: From a seated position, twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
